tests/test_ci_v3_reference_admission_suc.isolation_proof: Read-only and stateless: every test builds synthetic phase/native reports in memory (fixture()) and calls the pure validators of tools/ci_v3_production.py; the only real inputs are Git objects and working-tree bytes of the unchanged checkout (d029_source_facts()). No test writes a file, commits, changes cwd or environment, or has a module/session fixture; the one monkeypatch replaces prod.d029_source_facts with a deep-copied facts dict (data, not a verdict). Local evidence: docs/ci_v4/p2_full/ISOLATION_EVIDENCE.json - each of the 10 nodes passes alone in a fresh process.

tests/test_rcux_governance.py.isolation_proof: No fixture of its own; module-level constants are read-only reads of committed sources at import; every test reads the real tree and asserts (no write, no git mutation, no env/cwd change). Suite autouse module fixtures (tests/conftest.py executor/acquisition lifecycle) are re-created per process. Measured: 41 nodes, 2169 s, heaviest node 284 s (run 41912154663).

tests/test_u1_scope.py.isolation_proof: P1 (post-#457, main d32f4987): module fixture _tree creates its own detached worktree per process (tmp_path_factory) and removes it at teardown; fixture wt runs reset --hard + clean -fdx after EVERY test, so no test depends on another's state (same pattern as tests/test_wf06b_scope.py). The one test that commits (test_evaluation_at_a_commit_ref_matches_the_working_tree_and_rejects_a_foreign_ref: an empty commit) leaves the tree identical. Measured: the exact 3 parts the trusted scheduler derives from run 44147228493 node times ([1 node 977 s], [44 nodes 718 s], [55 nodes 718 s]) each pass in an independent process and clone (1/1, 44/44, 55/55), plus a seeded random-order run of the whole module (docs/ci_v4/p1_runtime/NODE_SPLIT_ISOLATION_PROOF.md). Floor: test_an_older_cohort_accepts_a_superseded_blob_only_through_the_exact_cohort = 977 s of 2413 s (run 44147228493); splitting cannot shorten that node.
